description: Weekly grouped dependency PRs on Gitea, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml (ADR 0064).

packageRules.description: Everything Gradle that is not a server platform.
Server platforms move with the Minecraft version, so one PR keeps them in step. mcprotocollib-previous is held by its own rule below.
Paper is pinned to the newest build MockBukkit runs; it moves by hand with MockBukkit after :msc-agent-paper:test passes (ADR 0052).
Fabric API versions end in the Minecraft line (0.166.0+26.3); it is bumped by hand with the Minecraft version (ADR 0012).
mcprotocollib-previous (same module as mcprotocollib) stays one Minecraft version behind for Minestom; it moves by hand with the Minecraft line, like this pattern.
v4+ refuses non-github.com servers, so Gitea stays on v3 (ci.yml).
